 Prayer:

Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India, fo
 issuance of a Writ of Mandamus to direct the 1st Respondent to act upon th
 petitioner's claim petition dated 17.06.2024 and to reconsider the Award
 dated 16.10.2023 and to pay the compensation for remaining trees, plants
 and 2 bore well and other plants and pay for future loss of income and to
 appoint the competent engineer to revalue the available structures in land
 measuring 3844 sq.mtrs. comprised in S.No.30/2B3 comprised in
 Echanahalli Village, Denkanikottai Taluk Krishnagiri, and enhance the
 compensation for land along with structures situated in the above said S.N
 by following the procedure contemplated under Section 26 to 30 Right to Fa
 Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and
 Resettlement Act 2013 (Central Act 30 of 2013) and follow Section 18 to 27
 of the Arbitration & Conciliation Act, 1996.
For Petitioner : Mr.R.Rameshraja

For Respondents :
 For R1 & R2 : Mr.R.P.Murugan Raja
 Government Advocate
 For R3 : Mr.S.U.Srinivasan

Standing Counsel
 Order
Today when the matter is taken up for hearing, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the writ petition.
He has also made an endorsement to that effect.
_ __ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 2.
Accordingly, this writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
No cost.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
